job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
A growing organization is seeking a Senior Accountant to join its finance team. This role is well suited to a finance professional who enjoys working in environments where significant investment, evolving projects, and complex business decisions require thoughtful financial analysis.

The successful candidate will have an opportunity to work closely with leadership, contribute to financial planning and reporting, and help strengthen processes as the organization continues to grow.

About the Role

Reporting to senior finance leadership, the Senior Accountant will support financial reporting, project accounting, forecasting, budgeting, and capital expenditure management.

This position is particularly suited to someone who can move comfortably between detailed financial analysis and broader business priorities. You'll be expected to investigate the numbers, identify potential risks and opportunities, and help leadership make informed decisions about how resources are allocated.

What You'll Do

  • Support accurate financial reporting, analysis, and management reporting across the organization
  • Track capital projects, expenditures, commitments, and remaining budgets
  • Assist with forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis for major initiatives
  • Monitor project spending and ensure costs are accurately classified and tracked
  • Analyze financial information and provide practical insights to support business decisions
  • Work with leadership to identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Help evaluate whether capital is being deployed effectively and in line with approved objectives
  • Develop and improve financial processes as the organization expands
  • Build practical solutions when new financial or operational challenges arise
  • Provide financial analysis to support major projects and business initiatives
  • Contribute to scalable accounting and reporting processes as the finance function evolves

What You Bring

  • 3–5+ years of relevant accounting or finance experience; CPA designation is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong, directly relevant experience
  • Experience in a regulated, capital-intensive, or project-based industry is highly valued
  • Strong background in project accounting, capital expenditure tracking, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis
  • Experience working with significant development, research, construction, or other capital expenditures
  • Ability to track projects from initial budgets through execution and assess spending, forecasts, and variances
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of unfamiliar or evolving challenges
  • Comfortable operating in an environment where processes and priorities continue to develop
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate financial information into practical recommendations
  • A commercially minded approach with an understanding of how accounting and financial analysis support broader business decisions

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join a growing organization where the finance function is evolving alongside the business. You'll have meaningful exposure to leadership, major projects, capital planning, and process development rather than working within a narrowly defined accounting function.

The environment is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and suited to someone who wants to have a visible impact while continuing to broaden their financial and commercial expertise.

job.title: Senior Bookkeeper
job.description:
A company operating in the consumer goods and distribution space is seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper for a two-month contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on accounting professional who can work independently, bring financial records up to date, and maintain accurate and reliable accounting processes.

Reporting to the appropriate finance lead, the Contract Senior Bookkeeper will take ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping activities and month-end close responsibilities. The successful candidate will help address outstanding accounting work, strengthen the accuracy of financial records, and ensure reconciliations and supporting documentation are maintained going forward.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage month-end close activities and ensure accounting records are accurate and up to date
  • Prepare and post accruals, adjusting journal entries, and other required accounting transactions
  • Reconcile intercompany balances and investigate discrepancies
  • Prepare, review, and maintain accounting working papers and supporting documentation
  • Complete account reconciliations, including balance sheet accounts
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies in financial records
  • Address outstanding bookkeeping activities and bring accounts up to date
  • Maintain consistent bookkeeping procedures and month-end processes once outstanding items have been resolved
  • Review existing accounting records and processes to identify issues and determine appropriate solutions
  • Work independently to deliver accurate, complete, and timely accounting results

What You Bring

  • Strong hands-on experience in bookkeeping and accounting
  • Demonstrated ability to complete month-end close activities independently
  • Solid knowledge of accruals, journal entries, account reconciliations, and intercompany transactions
  • Strong working-paper preparation, documentation, and recordkeeping skills
  • Experience in consumer goods, manufacturing, distribution, or another inventory-based business is highly desirable
  • Ability to step into an existing accounting environment, learn established processes quickly, and work through outstanding items
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work remotely with minimal supervision while managing competing priorities
  • A proactive, dependable approach and commitment to maintaining accurate financial records

Why Join

This contract offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact by improving the accuracy and completeness of accounting records while helping establish consistent month-end processes. You’ll have the autonomy to take ownership of key bookkeeping activities, apply your technical expertise, and contribute to a more reliable and efficient accounting function.

job.title: Manager, Operational Finance
job.description:
A large organization operating in a capital-intensive industry is seeking a Manager, Operational Finance to join its finance team. This role is ideal for a finance professional with strong experience in cost accounting, project accounting, and financial analysis who enjoys working closely with operational teams and turning financial information into practical business recommendations.

Reporting to a senior finance leader, the Manager, Operational Finance will provide hands-on financial support to operational and project teams. The position will play an important role in understanding cost performance, monitoring budgets and forecasts, identifying financial risks, and supporting informed business decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze operating and project costs, identify key cost drivers, and investigate significant variances against budgets and forecasts
  • Prepare financial reporting for projects, including expenditure tracking, budget monitoring, and cost trend analysis
  • Partner with operational and project leaders to investigate financial variances, identify risks, and recommend practical actions
  • Support annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting for operating and capital expenditures
  • Contribute to month-end close activities, including accruals, reconciliations, cost coding, and allocation reviews
  • Ensure costs are recorded accurately and appropriately classified between operating expenses and capital investments
  • Monitor project commitments and spending to support accurate financial reporting and forecasts
  • Prepare clear financial reports and communicate key findings to finance leadership and non-financial stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen cost reporting, project accounting processes, and financial controls
  • Support senior finance leadership with analysis and other operational finance initiatives

What You Bring

  • Strong experience in cost accounting, cost analysis, variance analysis, and project accounting
  • Experience supporting operational budgets, capital expenditures, and project financial reporting
  • Background in a capital-intensive or project-driven environment is an asset
  • Ability to investigate financial results, understand the operational factors behind variances, and translate findings into clear recommendations
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with ERP or accounting systems
  • Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines
  • Degree or diploma in accounting, finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
  • CPA designation or progress toward a professional accounting designation is considered an asset

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible finance leadership role with meaningful exposure to both operational and project activities. You'll work closely with business leaders, influence financial decision-making, and help improve how costs and performance are managed across the organization. The role also provides opportunities to strengthen your commercial finance skills, contribute to process improvements, and expand your leadership experience within a complex operating environment.

job.title: Corporate Financial Analyst
job.description:
A respected organization with a broad business portfolio is seeking a Corporate Financial Analyst to join its finance team. This role is ideal for an accounting professional who enjoys combining detailed financial analysis with broader business insight and wants exposure to senior leadership and a range of corporate finance activities.

Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Corporate Financial Analyst will support financial reporting, analysis, tax compliance, cash flow planning, and other corporate finance activities. The position works with stakeholders across the organization and offers the opportunity to contribute to both recurring reporting requirements and special projects.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare and review periodic financial statements, supporting schedules, and working papers for multiple business entities
  • Assist with management reporting packages and materials for senior leadership
  • Prepare and analyze financial reports related to banking, inventory, costs, financing, and business performance
  • Support cash flow forecasting and analyze projected results against actual performance
  • Assist with financing activities, including reviewing financial documentation and supporting loan-related processes
  • Analyze financial results and explain significant variances against budgets, forecasts, and prior periods
  • Prepare and support various corporate and indirect tax filings
  • Develop financial reports and analysis in response to management requests
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and internal procedures
  • Process complex accounting transactions, journal entries, invoicing, and financial allocations
  • Support payment and fund-transfer activities when required
  • Provide guidance and knowledge-sharing to junior members of the accounting team
  • Contribute to special projects and other corporate finance initiatives as needed

What You Bring

  • Professional accounting designation
  • At least 3 years of relevant accounting or financial reporting experience
  • Strong financial reporting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, including experience working with large datasets and developing meaningful analysis
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly present financial findings and key issues to management
  • High level of accuracy, professional judgment, and attention to detail
  • Ability to balance detailed financial work with broader business objectives
  • Collaborative, positive, and solutions-oriented approach
  • Experience in a project-based or asset-intensive industry is considered an asset

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative corporate finance team where your work will support financial reporting and business decision-making across the organization. The role provides broad exposure to financial reporting, taxation, cash flow, financing, and business analysis, along with opportunities to work closely with senior leaders and contribute to process improvements and special initiatives.

job.title: Junior Finance Controller
job.description:
An established organization is looking for a Junior Finance Controller to join its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional who wants to move beyond traditional reporting and gain broader exposure to commercial decision-making, operations, and business performance.

About the Role

Reporting to a head of finance, this position combines core controllership responsibilities with business partnering and financial analysis. You'll work closely with teams across the organization, providing financial insight, maintaining strong accounting controls, and helping leaders make informed decisions.

The role is particularly well suited to someone at the Senior Accountant, Senior Financial Analyst, or Assistant Finance Manager level who is ready to broaden their responsibilities and develop toward a future leadership position.

What You'll Do

Financial Operations & Controllership

  • Support the record-to-report process, including reconciliations, financial reporting, and variance analysis
  • Contribute to month-end close activities and help ensure financial information is complete and accurate
  • Review purchasing and expenditure processes to understand how transactions flow through the business
  • Investigate and explain financial variances in partnership with operational teams
  • Provide accounting guidance and step in on more technical matters when required
  • Help maintain appropriate financial controls and reporting standards

Business Partnering

  • Partner with teams such as Marketing, Supply Chain, and other operational groups to provide financial guidance
  • Review budgets and forecasts prepared by business leaders, providing financial challenge, oversight, and support
  • Assist with investment and return-on-investment analysis
  • Prepare financial insights and materials to support business performance discussions
  • Translate financial results into practical recommendations for stakeholders

Working Capital & Cash Management

  • Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and inventory trends
  • Analyze movements in working capital and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Support cash management activities and help maintain visibility into short-term financial requirements
  • Work with internal teams to understand the operational drivers behind working capital performance

Growth & Development

  • Take on additional responsibilities as knowledge of the business develops
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives outside the core finance remit
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and financial visibility
  • Develop broader commercial and operational knowledge with the potential to grow into a larger finance leadership role

What You Bring

  • Approximately 3–5 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance, or a related role
  • Strong foundation in financial accounting and controllership
  • Experience with reconciliations, financial reporting, variance analysis, and month-end processes
  • Understanding of purchasing, expenditure, and working capital processes
  • Experience working with product-based businesses, such as consumer goods, retail, or manufacturing, is an asset
  • Public accounting experience with exposure to relevant industry clients will also be considered
  • CPA designation or progress toward a professional designation is an asset, but not required
  • Strong Excel skills and experience with an ERP or financial management system
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable working in a lean environment where flexibility and a hands-on approach are important

Why Join

This role offers the opportunity to build a well-rounded finance career in an environment where your responsibilities can grow alongside your experience. You'll gain exposure to both technical accounting and commercial finance while working directly with leaders across the organization.

For the right candidate, this is more than a traditional controllership position—it’s an opportunity to develop broader business knowledge, take on increasing responsibility, and build toward the next stage of your finance career.

job.title: US Tax leader
job.description:
An established organization within the real estate space is seeking a US Tax Leader to oversee its US tax compliance and strategy. This role offers the opportunity to provide tax leadership across the organization while supporting effective tax planning, compliance, and tax optimization initiatives.

About the Role

Reporting to a senior finance leader, this position is responsible for overseeing US federal and state tax compliance, developing strategies to optimize tax outcomes, and leading the tax team. The role also involves close collaboration with stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely filings.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the preparation and review of US federal and state tax returns for the organization and its subsidiaries.

  • Develop and implement strategies to minimize tax liabilities while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.

  • Manage and mentor tax team members, providing technical guidance and support to ensure high performance.

  • Conduct research on US tax matters and stay updated on changes in tax laws and regulations.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to support accurate and timely tax reporting and compliance activities.

  • Identify and implement tax savings opportunities and strategies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and help strengthen the organization’s overall tax function.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; US or Canadian CPA or EA designation preferred.

  • 3–5 years of experience in US tax compliance and strategy.

  • Strong technical knowledge of US federal and state tax regulations and compliance requirements.

  • Proven leadership and mentoring skills.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities.

  • Experience in the real estate sector is an asset.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join an established organization where your tax expertise will have a direct impact on US tax compliance, planning, and strategy. The role offers leadership exposure, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the organization’s tax function.

job.title: Senior Internal Audit Analyst
job.description:
A diversified organization is seeking a Senior Internal Audit Analyst to strengthen its internal controls, risk management, and compliance practices. This is an opportunity for an experienced audit professional to take ownership of complex engagements, work closely with senior stakeholders, and contribute to initiatives that improve business processes and manage organizational risk.

Reporting to senior leadership within the audit and compliance function, this position will lead risk-based audit activities across multiple areas of the organization. The successful candidate will combine strong technical audit expertise with sound business judgment, helping identify risks, strengthen controls, and provide practical recommendations that support effective decision-making. The role also offers opportunities to contribute to broader risk initiatives, mentor junior team members, and participate in projects that have visibility across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate internal controls and business processes to identify control gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement
  • Plan and execute internal audit engagements from initial risk assessment and scoping through fieldwork, reporting, and follow-up
  • Develop risk-based audit approaches that reflect organizational priorities and changing business requirements
  • Perform detailed testing of controls, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation
  • Prepare clear audit findings and recommendations and communicate results to management and key stakeholders
  • Support enterprise-wide risk management activities, including identifying, assessing, and monitoring significant business risks
  • Work with business leaders to develop practical approaches to address identified risks and strengthen control environments
  • Track remediation activities and follow up on outstanding audit recommendations
  • Collaborate with internal teams, external auditors, and other stakeholders to coordinate audit and compliance activities
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior members of the audit team
  • Monitor developments in audit practices, regulatory expectations, and risk management methodologies
  • Participate in special projects, investigations, and other assignments as required

What You Bring

  • University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline
  • Professional designation is required (CPA, CIA, or equivalent)
  • 3–5 years of progressive experience in internal audit, risk, compliance, or a closely related function
  • Experience assessing internal controls, conducting risk assessments, and applying established audit methodologies
  • Strong understanding of governance, risk management, and internal control principles
  • Experience planning and managing audit engagements from start to finish
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to management
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, integrity, and sound judgment
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and strong ability to work with spreadsheets, presentations, and business analysis tools

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on meaningful audit and risk responsibilities within a collaborative professional environment. You'll have visibility across different areas of the organization, work directly with business leaders, and play an important role in strengthening processes, controls, and risk management practices.

job.title: Director, Controllership & Treasury
job.description:
A leading global organization is seeking a Director of Finance to oversee controllership, treasury, financial reporting, and operational accounting activities across a complex business platform. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for an experienced accounting or finance professional who enjoys building scalable processes, strengthening controls, and working closely with senior stakeholders.

About the Role

Reporting to senior finance leadership, this position will play a key role in strengthening the organization's finance infrastructure. You'll oversee financial close and consolidation activities, provide technical accounting guidance, manage treasury operations, and lead initiatives that improve processes and controls.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee financial close and reporting activities across multiple entities
  • Lead consolidation processes, including intercompany activity and related adjustments
  • Prepare financial analysis, management reporting, and materials for senior leadership
  • Maintain effective internal controls and support compliance with applicable accounting standards and organizational policies
  • Coordinate with internal and external audit teams and manage related information requests
  • Research complex accounting matters and prepare technical documentation supporting significant transactions
  • Evaluate accounting considerations related to investments, acquisitions, restructurings, dispositions, and financing activities
  • Oversee treasury operations, including cash positioning, liquidity management, banking relationships, and payment approvals
  • Coordinate funding, distributions, capital activity, and intercompany cash movements
  • Provide guidance on complex accounts payable matters and help resolve payment or operational exceptions
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the efficiency and scalability of finance operations
  • Act as a key business partner for finance-related systems and process improvements
  • Lead, coach, and develop finance team members while promoting accountability and continuous improvement
  • Support strategic projects, special initiatives, and evolving business priorities

What You Bring

  • CPA, CA, or equivalent professional designation preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
  • 8–15+ years of progressive experience across controllership, treasury, accounting, or finance
  • Experience within financial services, investment management, or another complex financial environment is an asset
  • Strong knowledge of applicable accounting standards, including IFRS and/or U.S. GAAP
  • Experience with financial consolidation, technical accounting, treasury operations, and internal controls
  • Strong experience with ERP or financial management systems
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, implement controls, and identify opportunities for automation
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where processes and priorities continue to evolve
  • Proven leadership ability with experience coaching and developing finance professionals

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible finance leadership role within a sophisticated and evolving organization. You'll have the opportunity to influence financial infrastructure, work alongside senior stakeholders, lead meaningful operational improvements, and help shape a finance function designed to support long-term growth.

The role also provides meaningful exposure to complex financial activities, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration, with the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the organization's finance operations.

job.title: Property Accountant
job.description:
A growing real estate organization is looking for a Property Accountant to join its accounting team. This role is well suited to an accounting professional who wants to move beyond transactional work and develop a deeper understanding of how commercial properties operate, perform, and create long-term value.

About the Role

Reporting to an Accounting Manager, the Property Accountant will manage full-cycle accounting for a portfolio of income-producing properties. You’ll work closely with teams across property management, leasing, operations, legal, and corporate finance, giving you broad exposure to both the financial and operational sides of the business.

The role offers an opportunity to take ownership of a portfolio, build strong stakeholder relationships, and develop into a trusted financial partner to the broader organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting activities for an assigned portfolio of commercial properties
  • Prepare working papers, reconciliations, financial analyses, and supporting schedules
  • Review banking activity, accounts payable transactions, receivables, and other financial information for accuracy
  • Investigate variances and discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve issues
  • Monitor and forecast property-level cash flow requirements
  • Review lease-related financial information and assess its accounting impact
  • Maintain and analyze tenant and property-related schedules
  • Review project and funding documentation as required
  • Prepare quarterly financial and lease reporting, including variance analysis and updated forecasts
  • Support annual budgeting and reforecasting activities
  • Prepare financial statements and audit documentation in accordance with applicable accounting standards
  • Complete common-area expense reconciliations and support related tenant billing
  • Partner with property administrators, property managers, leasing teams, legal professionals, and corporate accounting on financially significant matters
  • Contribute to process improvements and other accounting projects as needed

What You Bring

  • CPA designation or progress toward completion, or 2+ years of relevant accounting experience
  • Experience in property accounting, property management, commercial real estate, or a related environment is an asset
  • Strong understanding of full-cycle accounting and financial reporting
  • Advanced or highly proficient Microsoft Excel skills
  • Experience with property management or ERP systems is an asset
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborative, dependable, and solutions-oriented approach
  • Ability to learn quickly and take ownership of responsibilities
  • Genuine interest in understanding the operational drivers behind commercial real estate performance

Why Join

This is an opportunity to build your accounting career within a collaborative and growth-oriented environment while gaining meaningful exposure to commercial real estate. You’ll have ownership of a portfolio, regular interaction with different areas of the business, and the opportunity to develop both your technical accounting expertise and broader business knowledge.

For someone looking to become more than a numbers-focused accountant, this role provides the chance to understand the story behind the financial results and see how accounting connects to the performance of real-world assets.

job.title: Payroll Manager
job.description:
A diversified organization is seeking an experienced Payroll Manager to lead its payroll function. This is a high-impact opportunity for a payroll professional who combines strong technical knowledge with people leadership, compliance expertise, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Reporting to senior finance or people leadership, the Payroll Manager will oversee payroll operations across Canada and the United States, ensuring accurate and timely processing while maintaining compliance with applicable payroll and employment requirements. The position will work closely with Human Resources, Finance, Benefits, Accounting, and business leaders. It will also contribute to organizational changes, business integrations, system initiatives, and other projects that support the continued evolution of the payroll function.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the accurate and timely processing of payroll for hourly and salaried employees across multiple jurisdictions
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, provincial, state, and local payroll, tax, wage, and employment requirements
  • Oversee payroll reconciliations, remittances, year-end activities, and statutory reporting
  • Review payroll results and resolve discrepancies or complex transactions before final processing
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Canadian and U.S. payroll legislation, taxation, and best practices
  • Lead, coach, and develop payroll team members while promoting accountability and continuous improvement
  • Establish and maintain effective payroll controls, policies, procedures, and audit practices
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Benefits, Accounting, and operational leaders on payroll-related initiatives
  • Support business integrations and organizational changes, including employee onboarding, payroll transitions, data validation, and process alignment
  • Monitor legislative developments and implement required changes to payroll processes and systems
  • Develop payroll reporting, metrics, and analytics to support operational and business decisions
  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement to increase efficiency and scalability
  • Coordinate payroll-related audits and compliance reviews, ensuring documentation and responses are complete and timely
  • Act as a key business owner and subject matter expert for the organization's payroll systems
  • Oversee payroll configuration, earnings and deductions, tax setup, workflows, testing, upgrades, and troubleshooting
  • Partner with HR technology teams, Finance, and external service providers to improve system functionality
  • Lead testing associated with system enhancements, regulatory changes, and payroll initiatives
  • Maintain strong payroll data integrity through regular reviews, system monitoring, documentation, and standardized procedures

What You Bring

  • Professional payroll designation required; advanced payroll certification is an asset
  • 8+ years of progressive payroll experience, including responsibility for Canadian and U.S. payroll operations
  • 3+ years of experience leading and developing payroll teams
  • Strong knowledge of multi-jurisdictional payroll taxation and compliance
  • Hands-on experience administering a major payroll or HRIS platform
  • Experience supporting payroll activities related to acquisitions, integrations, or organizational transitions
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, reporting, and year-end processes
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a critical business function within a collaborative and evolving organization. You'll have meaningful influence over payroll operations, systems, compliance, and process improvement while leading a team and partnering with stakeholders across the business.

job.title: Accounting Technician
job.description:
A professional services organization is seeking an Accounting Technician to support a diverse portfolio of clients with accounting, tax compliance, and financial reporting needs.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can manage client files independently, work across multiple deadlines, and deliver accurate, high-quality work with minimal supervision. You’ll work closely with experienced accounting professionals while building your technical knowledge and client-service skills.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform bookkeeping, account reconciliations, and general accounting tasks as required
  • Prepare working paper files and financial information for compilation engagements
  • Prepare corporate and personal income tax returns and related filings
  • Prepare indirect tax, payroll, and information returns as required
  • Communicate with clients to obtain information and respond to routine inquiries
  • Correspond with government tax authorities regarding client matters
  • Manage multiple client files and competing deadlines
  • Provide regular updates to managers on file progress and outstanding items
  • Identify issues, gather relevant information, and escalate matters when appropriate
  • Monitor workload and communicate changes or budget considerations to management
  • Maintain accurate time and file records
  • Follow established accounting, tax, documentation, and quality-control procedures
  • Stay current with relevant technical requirements and apply them accurately
  • Support additional accounting and tax projects as needed

What You Bring

  • Diploma or degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 2+ years of relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience, ideally within a public accounting environment
  • Working knowledge of Canadian personal and corporate tax compliance
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with accounting and document-management systems
  • Experience preparing working papers, reconciliations, and tax-related filings
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a client-focused approach
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
  • Ability to manage multiple files and deadlines, particularly during busy periods
  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to seek guidance
  • Experience with accounting, tax preparation, or practice-management software is an asset

Why Join

Join a collaborative professional environment where you can work with diverse clients, strengthen your accounting and tax expertise, and take meaningful ownership of your work while continuing to grow professionally.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
A diversified organization within the real estate sector is seeking a Senior Accountant to join its finance team. This is an opportunity for an experienced accounting professional to take ownership of financial reporting, contribute to business planning, and work closely with operational teams across a varied portfolio.

Reporting to the Controller, the Senior Accountant will be responsible for a broad range of accounting and financial reporting activities. You'll take ownership of the period-end close, support budgeting and forecasting, review property-related financial information, and help ensure that financial records are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable accounting requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of month-, quarter-, and year-end accounting activities for a portfolio of business entities
  • Prepare and review financial statements, supporting schedules, and working papers
  • Complete journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, and general ledger reviews as part of the close process
  • Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations, including cash, financing, intercompany, and other key accounts
  • Investigate unusual balances and variances and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues
  • Support corporate tax compliance and coordinate information required for external filings
  • Analyze financial results against budgets and prior periods, providing clear explanations and insights to management
  • Assist with annual budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow planning
  • Review property-related income and expenses and ensure financial information is accurately reflected in the accounting records
  • Support the review and administration of tenant and contractual financial information
  • Monitor cash requirements and work with internal stakeholders to support effective liquidity management
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day guidance to junior accounting staff
  • Participate in special projects and other finance initiatives as required

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field
  • CPA designation, or active progress toward a CPA designation, is preferred
  • Progressive accounting experience, with a demonstrated track record of independently managing financial reporting and period-end close activities
  • Strong experience preparing, reviewing, and interpreting financial statements and supporting schedules
  • Confidence working with multiple entities, complex balance sheet accounts, and detailed reconciliations
  • Experience supporting corporate tax compliance and financial reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, internal controls, and financial reporting standards
  • Experience in real estate, property, or another asset-intensive environment is an asset
  • Advanced Excel capabilities and confidence working with large or complex financial datasets
  • Experience with ERP, accounting, or financial management systems
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently
  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a commitment to accuracy and continuous improvement

Why Join

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful accounting responsibilities while gaining broad exposure to financial reporting, business planning, operations, and commercial decision-making.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
A dynamic organization is looking for a Senior Accountant to join its finance team. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership of financial processes, working with complex financial information, and contributing to the accuracy and effectiveness of the broader finance function.

Reporting to senior accounting leadership, this position will play an important role in the organization's accounting and financial reporting activities. The role combines hands-on accounting responsibilities with analysis, reporting, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to improve existing processes.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain accurate financial records and oversee accounting activities across assigned areas of the general ledger
  • Complete detailed account and balance sheet reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure outstanding items are resolved promptly
  • Lead or contribute to monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities while ensuring reporting deadlines are met
  • Prepare financial statements, management reports, supporting schedules, and detailed financial analysis
  • Review financial results, investigate significant variances, and communicate relevant trends and findings to leadership
  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities
  • Coordinate audit preparation by maintaining appropriate schedules, documentation, and supporting information
  • Monitor compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, and established financial procedures
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to provide accounting guidance and support informed business decisions
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting practices, and overall efficiency
  • Contribute to finance projects and other initiatives that strengthen the organization's financial operations

What You Bring

job.title: Financial Analyst, FP&A
job.description:

job.title: Cost Accountant

job.title: Construction Accountant
